reviews.title: Where are all the recipes that were previously added to favorites?
reviews.text: Before, there was no need to create a profile, so many recipes were saved that it would be easier to plan meals for the week. Now they have come up with a profile, but to search for everything again. I don't understand why I have to waste time searching for recipes that have already been saved a second time...

reviews.title: Where are the videos?
reviews.text: Where are the wonderful videos that made this app such a good tool? Please bring them back!!

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Had an account for ages and suddenly, lost all of my saved receipes.  Trying to log in, gives me an error message.  Looks as if you are now trying a subscription.  Forget it, I will find my receipes elsewhere.

reviews.title: nothing is free :(
reviews.text: life used to be good but now time for joy is over! i remember when apps use to be free there no paywall all people were equal! what is the life if all you own are subscriptions? so does a man truly own anything? he has lost his soul to corporate greed.

reviews.title: Too much clutter and AI
reviews.text: Used to be a really simple, straight forward app. Now it’s full of clutter and is difficult to use. Also noticed the photos for the recipes are stating to be used making AI- makes me not trust the recipes 😅

reviews.title: Keeps begging you to subscribe
reviews.text: Can’t turn the damn thing off. It’s a massive irritant

reviews.text: Good app of all you eat is pasta

reviews.text:
Since they continue to update now all I get bombarded with is try kitchen stories plus. I can’t even view one recipe or swipe to another recipe without having a popup
